question: By whose agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā operate up to the limit of māyā?
premises: The operation extends up to māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī Icchā, associated with the siddhas, acts up to māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The precise syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and māyāntaṃ is ambiguous.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to the limit of māyā.
